trials.description: Current main CPU kernels, cold unique short/medium/long requests, browser baseline harness
Packed 4x8 output-lane Q8 GEMM: 6.4 percent slower end to end; 1400 kernel cases and both model/cache guards passed; parent fc8e1ee
Reuse Laya worker transfer buffers: Laya geomean 645.807 ms, 5 percent faster; six-case 2.3 percent faster; both model/cache guards pass; parent 633676a
Kev recurrence value tiling: 14 percent slower overall despite unchanged numerical/cache results; parent 18566a8
Packed Q8 GEMM with KC256 chunks: 60.6 percent slower than retained browser metric despite passing 1400 kernel cases and model/cache guards; parent 8d3020c
3x4 SIMD tile: 47.1 percent slower overall, likely register pressure; 1400 kernel cases and model/cache parity passed; parent bf8ce68
Three consecutive slower kernel layouts: retain existing 2x4 and switch to sampled profiles plus actual tile-selection metadata before trying a smaller register tile and SIMD worker reduction
3x3 SIMD tile selected on every worker but 5.1 percent slower than retained browser metric; all kernel/model/cache checks passed; parent 9e14cc9
Profiles confirm 78-82 percent linear but every wider or repacked tile loses; abandon register-layout expansion and optimize JS/WASM shard reduction plus profiled transcendental math
SIMD shard reduction: Laya 611.266 ms and Kev 2598.316 ms; 3 percent overall gain versus retained best; model/cache guards pass; parent f52a4fcd64995973d44726b28e0de69df02569a6

Vector exponential: 125156 WASM inputs max 1 ULP, native attention and model/cache guards pass, but Laya 622.802 ms is 1.9 percent slower; parent d61c9b4; production fd002c3 and guard 6e65aec reverted together
64 KiB activation blocks: Laya 757.405 ms, Kev 4204.359 ms; 41.6 percent slower overall; 1400 numerical cases and model/cache guards pass; parent bd83365
1 MiB activation blocks: Laya 591.064 ms, Kev 2405.052 ms; 5.4 percent faster than retained metric and 10.4 percent below baseline; 1400 numerical cases and model/cache checks pass; parent 7615c4b
